title: VPC & On‑Prem Clinic — Sprint Checkin (Nov 2026)
content:
TL;DR: Focused week on three escalations — Helios network MTU mismatch, Nimbus HSM/KMS handshake failures, Atlas k8s node-affinity fallout. Made progress on an automated preflight check that catches common firewall/NAT issues; still need a docs pass and a small UX change before rolling to field installs.

Attendees: Aisha, Marco, Leah, Samir, Jenna (Solutions), Ben (Field SE sync)

Current sprint goals (clinic scope):
- Harden install preflight checks to reduce first-week config tickets by 40%
- Stabilize HSM/KMS handshake path for on-prem with strict ciphers
- Add observability-agent health metadata to the default installer manifest

Highlights this week:
- Preflight v0.3 landed in branch installer/clinic-preflight (PR 278). Adds checks: MTU detection, proxy auto-detect via CONNECT test, and simple outbound reachability to Redwood control-plane endpoints. Manual validation against 5 customer networks passed.
- Helios: found systemic MTU mismatch (customer network 1400, container overlay default 1500). Applied a temporary workaround (set kube-flannel MTU to 1400) and created PD-9402 to track permanent fix (we should add MTU auto-tune in installer).
- Nimbus: intermittent HSM handshake failures traced to aggressive TLS session resumption with the vendor appliance. Worked with Leah and security team to tighten cipher negotiation and added a 2s retry backoff. Confirmed handshake success in 8/8 lab runs.
- Atlas: Node-affinity rule generation bug caused pods to schedule to tainted nodes when mixed GPU/CPU pools existed. Marco pushed a hotfix to affinity generator; still watching rollout on staging.

Open blockers / risks:
1) Firewall/NAT visibility gap (Helios & two other prospects) — some edge firewalls rewrite TCP MSS which breaks long token streams. We need to ship a clearer KB article and a one-click installer telemetry toggle to capture packet-level symptoms. Risk: additional install-hours for field SEs.
2) HSM vendor requires a specific company CA chain for mutual TLS in their appliance; customers without CA management will need assistance. This is a people-time risk for early customers.
3) Observability agent current image is 1.2.0 and lacks the new trace correlation headers; until we update images, customer metrics will be fragmented across control plane and host.

Customer-specific notes:
- Helios (financial services, EU): Install window 11/10 delayed until network team applies MTU change. They want an installer flag to force overlay MTU. Action: Samir to draft MTU flag RFC and quick patch by 11/12.
- Nimbus (healthcare): HSM handshake flaky during key rotation. On-call from vendor scheduled a joint session 11/09. Action: Leah to run rotation sim and capture handshake logs + upload to PD-9345.
- Atlas (adtech): Rolling canary failed due to affinity bug; canary traffic re-routed to fallback cluster. Action: Marco to complete hotfix rollout and validation by 11/11; if green, schedule customer-facing postmortem.

Operational work & experiments:
- Installer telemetry: added a lightweight 'connectivity-diagnostic' dump that can be toggled on/off with --diag. This produces consolidated output: local routes, MTU, iptables nat table head, and traceroute to control-plane. Needs docs.
- Preflight UX: we should gate the preflight as opt-in for existing customers until we collect anonymized false positives. Proposed: enable-by-default for new installs; opt-in for upgrades.
- Cost/latency observation: observed a 6% median token latency improvement when prefix caching enabled in warm starts for on-prem clusters. Anecdotal but repeatable in lab.

Action items (owners + due dates):
- Samir: MTU flag RFC + patch for installer (due 2026-11-12)
- Leah: Run HSM rotation sim and attach logs to PD-9345 (due 2026-11-09)
- Marco: Complete affinity hotfix rollout + staging perf check (due 2026-11-11)
- Jenna: Draft KB for firewall/NAT MSS issues, include packet examples (due 2026-11-15)
- Aisha: Docs pass and rollout note for preflight v0.3; coordinate opt-in strategy with Product (due 2026-11-16)

Notes to field SEs (quick wins):
- If customer sees token truncation on long replies, ask for traceroute and MTU check first (most often MSTP/MSS rewrite).
- For HSM errors, request vendor appliance logs for mutual TLS and check clock skew > 30s.
- Enable preflight --diag for problematic networks and request the dump tarball; it has been key to diagnosing recent installs.

Decisions needed from Product/Legal this week:
- Default telemetry opt-in for new installs (Product decision by 11/13).
- Template customer engagement SLA for HSM-managed key rotation support (Legal/RevOps to review draft)

Misc / chatbot notes:
- Quick reminder: drop the latest tracer utility into the installer image (so we avoid customer env toolchain mismatch). Ben is prototyping a small statically linked tracer that should be ready next week.

Meeting log excerpts (raw):
- "Helios network is a showstopper until MTU is aligned. We can workaround but need an installer flag — field time is precious." — Field SE
- "HSM vendor wants mutual TLS but their appliance resets sessions when it sees session resumption headers. We should disable resumption for that path." — Leah

Attachments / references: see linked_artifacts above. If you want quick context replay, check the Slack thread #pd-clinic or the Confluence space.

Next check-in: weekly clinic sync on Monday 11/15 09:30 PT.

— Aisha
